Text:

HERNIA REPAIR SURGERY

Surgical prophylaxis is recommended for hernioplasty and herniorrhaphy.  For

patients known to be colonized with MRSA, add a single dose of vancomycin

to the preferred agent (cefazolin).

Antimicrobials are not indicated after incisions are closed.

[DVT prophylaxis orders](orz-gmenu-dvt-prophylaxis)

# Preferred prophylaxis

[Cefazolin Weight Based Dosing Preop R](surg-cefazolin-weight-based-dosing)

# For patients colonized with MRSA *ADD* Vancomycin in addition to cefazolin:

[Vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV beginning 120 minutes before incision \($\) R](orzid2-gmenu-surg-vancomycin-weight-based-dosing)

# Alternative for patient with beta lactam allergy
